speaker: Doctor
text: I am ready to evaluate your skin condition. Please describe the appearance, location, and any changes in the lesions you are concerned about, as I need to focus on potential oncologic issues.

speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma (SCC) of the penis and digit.

Based on your history of heavy smoking, African origin, and non-healing lesions despite treatment for syphilis and eczema, these findings are highly suspicious for squamous cell carcinoma. I will need to confirm this with a biopsy.
